about: Hand-written verdicts for the clip catalog, one per clip, from watching each native preview (strips at 15 fps, 30 fps bursts). Graded 2026-11-07 by six agents to verdicts/BRIEF.md; per-group files in verdicts/. tools/clip_catalog.mjs build reads this.

mx_baseball_pitching.line: good for: a real pitcher's windup and pitch, set 0-0.4 s, knee lift 0.5-1.4 s, stride 1.4-1.6 s, arm cocked 1.6-1.95 s, release at 2.03 s, big follow-through with the back leg kicked high 2.1-2.5 s, settled 3.6 s; weak at: a quick throw (2 s windup; start at 1.4 s to cut it); needs: play once
mx_baseball_pitching.watched: strip 0-5.2 s, own full-body bursts 1.9-2.9 s

mx_boxing_dodge.line: good for: a boxer's bob and weave in guard, ducks under 0.2-0.5 s, leans back away from a swing 0.8-1.1 s (head tipped back), steps out 1.2-1.5 s, guard back 1.8 s, loops cleanly; weak at: throwing a punch (no strike in it); needs: nothing

mx_cross_punch.line: good for: a big looping overhand right with a lunge (reads as a haymaker more than a straight cross), arm cocked high 0.86-0.93 s, arm straight at 1.07 s (hit), held to 1.2 s, guard back 1.35 s; weak at: a tight jab/cross (the elbow loops over the head first) and anything talky (fists); needs: play once
mx_cross_punch.watched: strip 0-4.3 s, hands burst, own full-body burst 0.9-1.4 s

needs: cut or blend out by 1.25 s (arm hangs extended 1.0-1.55 s)
mx_hook_punch.line: good for: a wide right hook from a boxing guard, wind-up 0.5-0.85 s, fist crosses his centre at 1.0 s (hit), fully out 1.03-1.07 s, guard back by 1.65 s; weak at: talk or any gesture (fists the whole clip); needs: play once, leave by ~1.25 s because the arm stalls out straight for half a second
mx_hook_punch.watched: strip 0-4.3 s, hands burst (0.43-1.4 s), own right-half burst 0.8-1.3 s

mx_roundhouse_kick.line: good for: a head-high roundhouse with the right leg, chamber 0.7-0.8 s, leg out straight at 0.93 s (hit), top at 1.0-1.07 s, foot down 1.45 s; weak at: medium shots (1.1-1.35 s the left hand is splayed stiff and sweeps across his face, torso leans way back); needs: frame full body, play once, relaxed grip
mx_roundhouse_kick.watched: strip 0-5 s, own bursts 0.57-1.07 s full body, 1.1-1.6 s both cameras

needs: cut by 1.1 s (the rest is standing with dead arms)
mx_throw.line: good for: a light one-arm overhand toss from a stand, arm up 0.7-0.83 s, release at 0.87 s (hand forward at shoulder height, fingers open), arm down by 1.0 s; weak at: a hard throw (no step, no torso, just the arm) and anything after 1.0 s (passive stand); needs: play once and leave by 1.1 s
mx_throw.watched: strip 0-4.4 s, own bursts 0.7-1.2 s both cameras

mx_throwing.line: BANNED: no release: the throwing hand sits flat beside his cheek and shoves like a shot-put: use mx_goalie_overhand_throw or mx_baseball_pitching. Was: good for: little; a step and an open-palm push forward, release about 2.45 s; weak at: throw (the throwing hand is held flat and spread beside his face 1.9-2.3 s, palm nearly on the cheek, then shoves forward like a shot-put; no snap) and 2.6-5.5 s is a long stand with claw-spread fingers; needs: relaxed grip if used at all
mx_throwing.watched: strip 0-5.6 s, own bursts 1.75-2.25 s right, 2.0-2.5 s full body
mx_throwing.banReason: no release: the throwing hand sits flat beside his cheek and shoves like a shot-put: use mx_goalie_overhand_throw or mx_baseball_pitching

mx_throw_object.line: good for: pick something up off the ground and hurl it, bends to the floor 0.5-1.4 s (hand at the ground ~1.0 s), rises and squares up 1.5-2.0 s, arm back overhead 2.3-2.43 s, release at 2.5 s with a big forward lunge and follow-through 2.5-2.8 s, upright 3.6 s; weak at: a quick throw (2.5 s of pick-up before it); needs: play once (start at 2.0 s for the throw alone)
mx_throw_object.watched: strip 0-4.9 s, own full-body burst 2.3-2.8 s

mx_goalie_overhand_throw.line: good for: a long full-body overhand throw (holds the ball at the chest 0-0.5 s, crow-hop 0.5-0.8 s, arm back 1.0-1.3 s, release at the top at 1.53 s, arm whips down 1.57-1.65 s), recovers by 1.9 s; weak at: anything small; needs: play once
mx_goalie_overhand_throw.watched: strip 0-3.3 s, own full-body burst 1.3-1.8 s

needs: camera off his right side, not front (his right hand crosses his face 0.36-0.6 s from the front)
mx_goalie_catch_mid.line: good for: hands up ready 0.2-0.6 s, then both hands pull a chest-high ball in to the belly, closed at 0.75 s, held to 1.27 s; weak at: a clean two-hand close (the hands come in side by side, not around a ball) and front framings (open hand over the face 0.36-0.6 s); needs: play once, side angle, a prop catch at 0.75 s
mx_goalie_catch_mid.watched: strip 0-1.8 s, own bursts 0.3-0.8 s both cameras

mx_hit_reaction.line: BANNED: only the head snaps on a frozen odd arm pose, and as a loop it twitches every 0.45 s: use mx_stomach_hit or stumble_backwards. Was: good for: at most a small head snap back at 0.1 s as a head layer; weak at: hit-react (the body holds an odd pose, right forearm across the chest and left arm out flat, and only the head moves; as a loop it twitches every 0.45 s); needs: mask head, play once
mx_hit_reaction.watched: strip 0-3 s, own right-half burst 0-0.5 s
mx_hit_reaction.banReason: only the head snaps on a frozen odd arm pose, and as a loop it twitches every 0.45 s: use mx_stomach_hit or stumble_backwards

mx_stomach_hit.line: good for: taking a body shot in a boxing guard, head jerks up 0.07-0.15 s, folds forward and down with a fist to the chest at 0.2-0.3 s (hit 0.2 s), hunched 0.3-0.6 s, back in guard by 1.2 s; weak at: a big knock-back (it is small and stays on the spot); needs: play once
mx_stomach_hit.watched: strip 0-3.6 s, own right-half burst 0.07-0.6 s

needs: stop at 0.6 s (or hand to ragdoll)
mx_flying_back_death.line: good for: a huge knock-back, hit at 0.07 s, blown off his feet 0.2-0.5 s, lands on his back 0.55 s; weak at: anything after 0.6 s (the backward roll sinks his head and chest under the lawn 0.9-1.1 s, then he ends folded in a knot with a shoe in his face 1.7-3.0 s); needs: play once and cut or ragdoll by 0.6 s
mx_flying_back_death.watched: strip 0-3.4 s, own full-body bursts 0.07-0.57 s and 0.6-1.1 s, end frame 3.4 s

needs: lift him off the ground (the clip lies at lawn level)
mx_falling_air.line: good for: a skydiver's freefall, belly down, arms out with flat open palms, small steady sway, loops cleanly (4.5 s); weak at: nothing it would be picked for; needs: put him in the air with fly or move (it lies on the lawn); open palms are right here
mx_falling_air.watched: strip 0-4.5 s, own right-half burst 1.0-1.5 s, full frame 2.0 s

needs: fly with face:"yaw" (the body is already horizontal)
mx_flying_idle.line: good for: a rigid torpedo superman glide, prone, arms back along his sides with fists, head down; weak at: anything that needs his face (he looks at the ground) and calm floating (it is nearly still, 0.25 m/s); needs: fly with face:"yaw" so he is not pitched twice, lift him off the lawn

mx_treading_water.line: good for: treading water or hovering in place, knees bent and pedalling, arms out sculling with flat palms down, calm 3 s loop; weak at: flying (no direction to it); needs: nothing (flat hands are the action)
mx_treading_water.watched: strip 0-3 s, own right-half burst 0.5-1.0 s

needs: a rope fx between his hands
mx_pull_rope.line: good for: hand-over-hand rope hauling from a stand, one arm reaches out then pulls into the chest, alternating about every 1 s (watched 4.6-12.6 s); weak at: a hard tug (mild effort, torso barely leans, hands only half closed); needs: a rope in the hands to sell it
mx_pull_rope.watched: strip (8 s from 4.57 s, cells too small), own sheet every 0.2 s of preview 0-4 s

mx_lift_heavy.line: BANNED: never lifts anything (squats, looks round, stands up empty-handed): misleading name. Was: good for: squatting down 0.8-1.6 s, staying low and looking around 3.5-6.4 s, standing back up about 8.2-8.7 s; weak at: lift (in the 0.8-8.8 s shown he never grips or raises anything, hands hang open at the knees; the last 2.7 s are not in the preview); needs: nothing; pick another clip for a lift
mx_lift_heavy.watched: strip 0.77-8.77 s, own sheet every 0.4 s, bursts preview 6.4-6.9 s and 7.4-7.9 s
mx_lift_heavy.banReason: never lifts anything (squats, looks round, stands up empty-handed): misleading name

mx_putting_down.line: good for: setting something on the floor, standing with the right hand carrying at his side to 3.3 s, a straight-legged bend to the ground, hand lowest about 4.7-5.9 s (release 4.7 s), upright by 7.5 s; weak at: close shots of the bend (stiff jack-knife, legs locked, head hanging, a bit mannequin), no grip on the carrying hand; needs: start about 2.5 s, a prop in the hand
mx_putting_down.watched: strip 1.5-9.5 s, own sheet every 0.4 s

mx_taunt_flex.line: good for: a fighter's taunt, guard with fist at the chin 0-0.8 s, both arms thrown wide (come on) 0.93-1.2 s, then hunched forward with forearms flexed down 1.3-2.5 s, back to guard 2.8 s; weak at: talk (fists, guard); needs: play once (fingers splay for 0.2 s at arms-wide, fine at speed)

needs: in the air with fly or a drop
0.7 s loop: nearly a held pose
falling_idle.line: good for: a frozen mid-air fall, knees bent apart, one arm flung up and one out, head ducked; weak at: anything on the ground (reads as an odd crouch) and close-ups (face hidden down by the arm); needs: put him in the air with fly or a drop, it barely moves

needs: raise him so the hands meet a bar or ledge
hanging_idle.line: good for: dangling from a bar or ledge or being hauled up by the hands, arms straight overhead, legs hanging, tiny sway, 4.7 s loop; weak at: surrender or celebration (it is a hang, not a reach); needs: lift him off the lawn so the hands meet what he holds

needs: move him forward, the clip runs in place
crawl_backwards.line: good for: a face-down crawl, dragging himself up from flat 0-0.3 s onto elbows and knees 0.5-1.3 s and reaching forward, flat again 1.5-2.0 s; weak at: crawling backwards despite the name (face down, going forward); needs: a move to carry him, it runs on the spot

needs: move him if he must travel (stays on the spot)

injured_stumble.watched: strip 0-5.1 s, own full-body burst 1.6-2.1 s

jumping_jacks.line: good for: clean jumping jacks, arms overhead and feet together at 0.0 s, arms down and feet out at 0.5 s, 1.07 s loop; weak at: a dance step (reads as exercise); needs: nothing
jumping_jacks.watched: strip 0-3 s, own full-body burst 0-0.5 s

mx_injured_stumble.watched: strip 0-5.1 s, own full-body burst 1.6-2.1 s (preview and strips byte-identical to injured_stumble)

mx_jumping_jacks.watched: strip 0-3 s, own full-body burst 0-0.5 s (preview and strips byte-identical to jumping_jacks)

sit_hit_snap.line: good for: a seated jolt, head and chest snap back over 0.03-0.07 s (hit 0.05 s) and stay tipped back looking up to 1.0 s, right hand on the belly; weak at: talk (head thrown back); needs: play once, a chair
sit_hit_snap.watched: strip 0-1.5 s, own right-half burst 0-0.5 s

mx_laughing.line: good for: a big laugh, head thrown back 1.6-3.2 s, then doubled over with a slap toward the knee 3.6-5.2 s, upright again by 5.6 s; fingers relaxed; weak at: talk or idle (the fold is deep, 25 deg, and the first 1 s and last 4 s are plain standing); needs: start at 1.2 s for the laugh alone
mx_laughing.watched: strip 0.4-8.4 s, hands burst (the fold), measures

mx_terrified.line: good for: fear, hands snap up 1.5-2.3 s into a deep cower (67 deg forward) with clawed hands, a fist pressed to the mouth 4.7-7.7 s, head darting left and right (up to 98 deg); weak at: anything upright (folded nearly the whole clip); needs: start at 1.5 s, a frontal or three-quarter camera so the fist reads as covering the mouth rather than sunk into it
mx_terrified.watched: strip 0.7-8.7 s, hands burst, own burst 5.0-5.5 s (fist at the mouth)

mx_sneak_fwd.line: good for: a tiptoe sneak cycle on a treadmill (1.67 s loop, no travel), crouched with arms out; weak at: real travel (feet cross and slide when carried) and the legs read stiff, the stance knee near-locked at times (measure 72 deg backward on 17 of 52 frames, not clearly a flip at this size); needs: relaxed grip (both hands flat and splayed the whole loop), a walk to carry it, a close look at the knees before using
mx_sneak_fwd.watched: strip 0-3.3 s, own full-body burst 0.2-0.7 s

mx_look_over_shoulder.line: good for: hands on hips with a look back over his left shoulder 0.3-2.6 s, then facing front hands on hips to 3.8 s; weak at: talk (no gesture); needs: relaxed grip (left hand fanned flat on the hip)

mx_standing_arguing.line: good for: heated talk, a flat 'hold on' palm raised beside his head 9.8-12.2 s (clear of the face), arms flung wide 12.2-13.4 s, both hands up 14.6-15.4 s, chest jabs after; weak at: calm talk or listening (big, fast, head tipped up a lot); needs: relaxed grip (palms stiff and spread through the sweeps; the stop palm can stay open)
mx_standing_arguing.watched: strip 9.8-17.8 s, hands burst, own burst 10.4-10.9 s

mx_sitting_talking.line: good for: seated talk to someone on his LEFT (head turned up to 66 deg), upright, no fold; small right-hand gestures 31.3-32.1 s and 33.3-34.1 s, left hand 35.7-36.5 s; weak at: a partner in front of him, drink, write; needs: relaxed grip (hands rest flat and spread on the thighs), chair 0.45 m

needs: pad or desk at lap height, pen in right hand
mx_writing_seated.line: good for: seated, head down, small writing moves of the right hand over the lap for the whole 5 s loop, mild 13 deg lean (not a fold); weak at: talk or anything to camera (face down); needs: relaxed grip on the LEFT hand (dead flat and spread the whole clip, curl 17), a pad or desk under the hands

mx_sitting_drinking.line: good for: steps and sits down 0.0-4.2 s (42 deg lean only during the sit), seated gesturing 4.2-7.2 s, cup hand to the chin 7.5-8.0 s with the head tipped back (at the chin, not in it); weak at: standing (the first 4 s stands and travels 0.16 m); needs: start at 4.2 s for seated, a chair, a cup prop (the empty half-curled hand reads odd)

mx_thumbs_up.line: BANNED: no thumbs up ever reads (a crouched fist pump) and the hand sweeps across his face 2.1-2.4 s: no catalogued thumbs-up exists, use a fingers set on a gesture clip. Was: good for: a crouched hype with fist pumps 1.2-3.0 s; weak at: a thumbs up (none reads, it is a fist), talk; the hand sweeps across his face 2.1-2.4 s and covers it from the front, deep crouch (48 deg lean); needs: a different clip for a thumbs up
mx_thumbs_up.watched: strip 0-4.2 s, hands burst, own bursts 1.9-2.4 s full body and medium
mx_thumbs_up.banReason: no thumbs up ever reads (a crouched fist pump) and the hand sweeps across his face 2.1-2.4 s: no catalogued thumbs-up exists, use a fingers set on a gesture clip

mx_blow_kiss.line: good for: a soft raised hand at shoulder height 0.6-2.2 s, then tossed outward palm open 2.4-3.2 s, a gentle send-off; weak at: an actual kiss (the hand never reaches the lips, closest 0.24 m); needs: relaxed grip (both hands flat and spread), a mouth touch from another clip if the kiss must read

mx_bow_formal.line: good for: a small polite bow, head and shoulders dip 0.4-1.0 s, back up by 1.6 s (lean only 14 deg); weak at: a big stage bow from the waist; needs: nothing

mx_excited.line: good for: an excited 'yes!' bounce, fists pumping, head up 0.3-4.8 s, settled by 5.2 s; real fists, no fanning; weak at: talk or listening; needs: nothing

mx_greeting.line: good for: a hello to someone above or far off, right hand up beside his head 1.6-3.8 s with small waves, head tipped up; weak at: a wave at eye level (he looks up); needs: relaxed grip (fingers splayed stiff right beside the temple, fanned 39% of frames)

mx_head_no.line: good for: a head shake no, 0.2-1.4 s, small and clean; weak at: anything with the arms (arms hang slightly out with flat hands); needs: mask: head over another body clip

mx_neck_stretch.line: good for: bored or stiff, head rolls to his left 0.4-1.1 s and right 2.0-2.6 s; weak at: talk; needs: mask: head (the body is a stiff pose, arms hanging away from the hips with flat hands)

mx_nod.line: good for: a yes nod, up 0.5-0.9 s, down 1.0-1.6 s, small and clean; weak at: arms (stiff, flat hands); needs: mask: head

mx_sigh.line: good for: a small sigh, head lifts 0.4-1.2 s and drops 1.6-2.4 s; weak at: a whole-body sigh (no visible chest or shoulder drop); needs: mask: head or upper, a face cue

mx_point_aj.line: good for: a dance pose hit, left arm high and right hand up before the chest, leaning back on bent knees 0.45-0.85 s, released by 1.2 s; weak at: a point (no index finger, the fingers fan), talk; needs: relaxed grip or a point grip

needs: index point grip on the right hand
mx_point_bent.line: good for: the reach of a point, right arm out at head height 0.5-0.7 s, held to 1.9 s, down by 2.3 s; weak at: a real point (the hand is open with stiff spread fingers, a claw; from the medium camera it crosses in front of the face 0.55-0.65 s); needs: a fingers set for an index point on the right hand

mx_point_vegas.line: good for: a lunge with finger guns, left arm points out with a real index at 0.43 s, right finger gun by the chin, held to 1.2 s, back by 1.4 s; weak at: talk; needs: nothing (no pops in the 30 fps burst)

mx_secret.line: good for: a whisper, leans to his left (35 deg) with the right hand raised flat beside the mouth 2.2-8.0 s (0.24 m off the face), straightens 8.0-8.6 s; weak at: anything else (the long lean is on nothing); needs: someone at his left, relaxed grip if the flat shield hand reads stiff

mx_shrug.line: good for: a shrug; NOT a T-pose on the current import (confirmed): palms turn up and out 0.4-0.6 s, held to 1.0 s, down by 1.6 s; weak at: anything else; needs: relaxed grip (palms flat and rigid; a set near 0.2 keeps them open but alive)
mx_shrug.watched: strip 0-4.0 s (two loops), hands burst 0-1.0 s

mx_thankful.line: good for: hand on heart, right hand to chest 0.4-0.9 s, a small head bow 0.8-1.6 s, release 1.9-2.3 s; weak at: talk; needs: relaxed grip (fingers a little spread on the chest)

mx_thinking.line: good for: thinking, fist to the chin 0.8-1.1 s (under the jaw, not into it), other hand on the hip, hold to 2.9 s, release 3.0-3.3 s; weak at: talk; needs: nothing

mx_wave.line: good for: a frantic hello only in a wide shot; weak at: a normal wave (0.53 s loop, fast; the stiff open palm sweeps across in front of his eyes every cycle, 0.0-0.15 s, covering the face from the front, 0.30 m off it); needs: relaxed grip, mx_wave_aj instead

mx_wave_aj.line: good for: a wave to the lens, arm up 0.3-0.5 s, waving 0.5-1.0 s at shoulder height clear of the face, down by 1.4 s; weak at: talk; needs: nothing (left hand a little fanned at his side, acceptable)

mx_weight_shift.line: good for: a near-still standing idle (9.4 s), very slight sway; weak at: talk; needs: relaxed grip (hands flat, arms held a little out, reads mannequin in a medium shot)

mx_shake_off.line: good for: shaking it off, turns away to his right 0-1.2 s, shakes the arms out 1.2-2.6 s, folds forward and shakes the head down 2.8-4.4 s (37 deg), recovers to stand by 5.2 s; weak at: talk; needs: relaxed grip (fingers fanned 26-34% of frames while shaking)

IdleBreathe.line: good for: a calm standing breath idle, relaxed hands, the whole 4 s loop; weak at: talk; needs: nothing

Idle1HaveNoClue.line: good for: an 'I have no clue' shrug, arms out palms up 0.3-1.4 s, down by 1.8 s, hands half-curled; better than mx_shrug for fingers; weak at: listening; needs: nothing
